transport_smoke_excluded.purpose: Verify public Responses API Fast/Priority routing only

objective: Test whether coding-native retrieval plus exact legal boundaries can preserve or improve long-horizon legal task quality while materially reducing source and context exposure relative to fair upstream Mike whole-document retrieval.

held_constant.claude_calibration: one fixed subset only if judge disagreement would change a decision

accepted_baselines.policy: Reuse the frozen upstream Mike and earlier coding/address Harvey cells. Rerun only if the parity audit identifies a concrete invalidation.

arms.h4: Glob/Grep/Read/Edit plus optional exact section, page, table-row, and direct resolved reference scopes; deterministic compiler checks run after mutation.
arms.h5: H4 plus Grep working_set, an immutable turn-local projection with a 64000 source-character default and 128000 hard cap, round-robin document allocation, row promotion for cell hits, and original-source evidence coordinates.

harvey_tasks.split: visible dev only; validation and sealed tasks forbidden

requirements: focused boundary and tool-contract tests pass
source receipts include text, page-map, and table-cell hashes
requested Fast tier fails closed unless the provider reports priority

sequence.selection: Prefer terse if no task loses more than 2 judge points and aggregate input tokens fall; otherwise retain operational. Treat ties as inconclusive, not a product decision.
Select accuracy at +3 or more aggregate judge points. Otherwise select economy if within 2 points and at least 15 percent lower input. Otherwise retain neutral.
Retain H5 only if aggregate score is within 2 points, no task drops more than 5 points, and input tokens are at least 15 percent lower.

specialized_dev_checks.contracts: exact sections, table cells promoted to rows, cross-references, and tracked edits
specialized_dev_checks.legislation: 150 and 150.1 are siblings; 150(1) and 150(2) are children of 150; bounded direct-reference neighborhoods report omissions
specialized_dev_checks.citator: 30-citation deterministic scope/ranking audit plus a live newest-versus-most_discussed comparison; no treatment labels
specialized_dev_checks.short_forms: Frozen 200-pair resolved-edge/style-of-cause sample. Unique mapping only; do not promote unless adjudicated precision is at least 0.95 with at least 100 adjudicated pairs.
specialized_dev_checks.legalrag: Strip document names and filename clues from prompts and model-visible metadata; do not rerun older cells solely for a harmless opaque document id.

failure_policy: Keep operational failures in receipts, separate them from retrieval misses, never replace tasks after seeing scores, and make no winner claim from partial or single-run noise.
